i: The adductor muscles, gracilis and obturator externus. A variable patch of skin on the medial thigh. Branches to the hip and knee joints.

nerves.n: Anterior cutaneous branches of femoral nerve
i: Iliacus, pectineus, sartorius and quadriceps. Skin of the front of the thigh and, through the saphenous nerve, the medial leg and foot. Branches to the hip and knee joints.
L1, L2
Genital branch: cremaster and the skin of the scrotum or labium majus. Femoral branch: skin over the femoral triangle.

Skin above the pubis and over the upper lateral buttock; motor twigs to internal oblique and transversus abdominis.
L3, L4
Skin of the medial leg down to the medial malleolus and the medial border of the foot; its infrapatellar branch supplies the skin below the kneecap. Sensory only.
L2, L3
Skin of the lateral thigh. Sensory only.
